blocks.text: Yeh principle (usool) sab se pehle Dutch scientist Christiaan Huygens ne bataya. Yeh aik geometrical method (drawing se hal karne ka tareeqa) hai: kisi lamhe par wavefront ki shakal maloom ho to us se thori der baad wavefront ki shakal nikali ja sakti hai. Huygens ne maana ke wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets (chhoti chhoti nayi waves) ka source hai. Yeh wavelets har direction mein usi speed se phailti hain jis speed se asal wave chal rahi hai.

Thori der baad ka naya wavefront woh surface hai jo tamam secondary wavelets ko bahar se chhooti hai (tangent hai). Is surface ko wavelets ka envelope (sab ko bahar se gherne wali surface) kehte hain.

Fig. 15.2 Huygens ka principle dikhati hai. Asal wavefront AB source se bahar ki taraf chal raha hai, jaisa arrows dikhate hain. Hamein time t ke baad wavefront ki shakal maloom karni hai. Maan lein ke wave ki speed v har jagah aik jaisi hai. To time t mein wavefront vt faasla tay karta hai. AB ke kai points ko centre bana kar radius vt ke circles banayein (yeh spherical wavelets ke nishan hain). In wavelets ka envelope, yani curve CD, naya wavefront hai.

blocks.alt: Left side source S aur us ke right curved primary wavefront AB jis par saat points hain. Har point se radius vt ka secondary wavelet bana hai; aik gulabi line aik radius dikhati hai aur vt wala arrow chalne ki direction. Tamam wavelets ko chhoone wali line CD secondary wavefront hai; aik chhote arc par wavelet likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.2: Pichhle wavefront se naye wavefront ka banna (kitab ki Figure 15.2 ke mutabiq hamara apna drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein primary wavefront ke oopar wale sire par 'S' aur arrow par 'yt' chhapa hai. Text ke mutabiq yeh A aur vt hain: wavefront AB hai aur har wavelet ka radius vt hai (speed v guna time t). Drawing mein A aur vt likha hai. Naya wavefront CD tamam wavelets ko chhoone wali line (envelope) hai.
Huygens ke principle se jo results milte hain woh sab Maxwell ki equations se bhi nikalte hain, lekin Huygens ka saada model istemal karna aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya Huygens ka principle awaz aur pani ki waves par bhi laagu hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Yeh har us wave par laagu hai jo aik fixed speed se chalti ho, is liye awaz aur pani ki waves ka phailna aur murna bhi isi tarah samjha ja sakta hai.

items: Wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets ka source hai.
Time t ke baad naya wavefront = radius vt wale wavelets ka envelope (CD).
Yahi results Maxwell ki equations se bhi milte hain; Huygens ka model aasan hai.
